# Pellak Construction

> > A.M. Pellak Construction provides design-build remodeling services specializing in kitchen and bathroom renovations across Pennsylvania's Main Line communities.

Pellak Construction serves homeowners in Bryn Mawr, Springfield, Havertown, Media, Radnor, and surrounding Pennsylvania townships with comprehensive home remodeling solutions. The company emphasizes design-build methodology, custom kitchen and bathroom design, and specialized services including aging-in-place modifications and historic home preservation.
